svg.text: The ladder: Size Magic goes deeper each grade
One plant, five depths; each rung's verbs, its units and its new places (transfer)
grade
Rung 4: Plant Explorer
ant-sized, ×50-300: the plant is a skyscraper
Verbs: guide water from soil to leaf · turn leaves to the sun · open petals for the bee
Units: g4.plant_animal_parts (plant half), g3.plants_needs
New places: the cactus stem · the water lily
grade
Rung 5: Built from Air
cell-sized, ×85,000: the leaf is a cathedral
Verbs: open and close the doors by the weather · let air in · carry sugar to the bud · test what builds a plant
Units: g5.plants_air_water, g5.sun_energy_food
New places: the desert night · the three beans · the pond bubbles
grade
Rung 6: One Cell
inside a cell, ×500,000: the cell is a palace
Verbs: fill the water balloon · turn chloroplasts to or away from the light · build the wall to the plan · feed the power stations
Units: g6.cells
New places: the animal-cell visitor · the onion
grade
Rung 7: Atom Builders
molecule-sized, ×2,000,000,000: atoms like footballs
Verbs: catch rare CO2 · split water with light · build the sugar ring carbon by carbon · burn it at night
Units: g7.photosynthesis
New places: the Mars dome · the bread rises
grade
Rung 8: The Whole Plant
the plant as a map: back out: the plant's roads
Verbs: keep the water rope whole · send sugar where it is needed · grow the giant pumpkin · design a plant
Units: g8.transport_systems (plant half)
New places: the cactus's secret · the winter tree · the lily's breath
Voyage 5.1 is everyone's prologue; the grade picks the default rung; every rung stays open; transfer voyages come after their idea.
